question: Where can I get a list of solar PV projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No national list of solar PV projects in permitting exists in the sources examined; permitting is split across federal (BLM) and state or local bodies. Best entry points: state registers (NY ORES, CEC Opt-In) and BLM ePlanning for federal land, plus EIA-860M as a national lead (1,100 planned PV generators with coordinates and approval-status codes, not a permit file).
main_caveats: No single federal body lists all projects; BLM covers only projects needing BLM action and state or county permits sit elsewhere.
EIA-860M status is survey-reported and undated, and the entity is not always the developer; the same applies to interconnection queues.
NY list and docket can disagree (Addison Solar 120 vs 105 MW); read the docket for the authoritative figures.
Only NY, California opt-in and two BLM pages were examined; Texas, Midwest, Southeast, Arizona and counties are pending.
BLM register records and the federal permitting dashboard could not be read from this environment.
answer.confidence_reason: Two state registers and a national lead were read; BLM records and the federal dashboard were not retrievable and most states were not examined.

sources.name: EIA-860M Monthly Update, 'Planned' sheet (solar PV generators with status codes)
sources.format: XLSX (sheets Operating, Planned, Retired, Canceled or Postponed, plus Puerto Rico)
sources.adds: Only nationwide, downloadable inventory of planned solar PV generators with coordinates, owner name and a status code that includes 'Regulatory approvals pending'; complementary, not a permit register.
sources.summary: Monthly national workbook: 1,100 planned PV generators with coordinates, MW, owner entity and status (approvals pending/received, construction).
sources.coverage_note: Nationwide but survey-based and not a permitting register.
caveats: Status has no date; owner is not always the developer.
Does not prove permits; use it to find the project, then the agency file.

coverage.geographic: United States and Puerto Rico; plants of at least 1 MW combined nameplate capacity.

unit.value: MW nameplate, net summer and net winter (columns M-O of the Planned sheet).

inclusion_rule.value: EIA page: tracks existing and proposed generating units at power plants with at least 1 MW of combined nameplate capacity; monthly figures are preliminary.

reference_date.value: Workbook 'Inventory of Planned Generators as of September 2026'; released 2026-10-23.

update_frequency.value: Monthly; next release 2026-11-24 (per the EIA page).

exclusions.value: Survey-reported by owners; EIA may correct figures later without notice; plants under 1 MW excluded. Status is not verified against permit files.

key_fields.field: Entity Name / Plant Name / Generator ID
key_fields.meaning: Reporting owner or operator entity (not necessarily the developer), plant and generator.
State and county.
Plant coordinates in the Planned sheet (present on all 1,100 solar PV rows).

key_fields.field: Nameplate Capacity (MW) / Net Summer / Net Winter
key_fields.meaning: Capacity in MW.

key_fields.field: Technology / Energy Source Code / Prime Mover Code
key_fields.meaning: 'Solar Photovoltaic' / SUN / PV.
(P) planned, approvals not initiated; (L) regulatory approvals pending; (T) approvals received; (U) under construction <=50%; (V) >50%; (TS) construction complete, not yet operating.
Expected start date; no date of the status itself.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL 'https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx' -o eia860m.xlsx  # sheet 'Planned', header on row 3; filter Technology == 'Solar Photovoltaic'
how_to_use.example_result: Entity 'Nautilus Solar Solutions' | Plant 'Sandoval 2' | IL, Clinton | 2 MW | Solar Photovoltaic | Planned operation 9/2026 | (L) Regulatory approvals pending. Not under construction | 38.5894, -89.1467
steps: Download the latest monthly workbook from the EIA page (September 2026 edition, 14,013,970 bytes).
Read sheet 'Planned' (data from row 4) and keep Technology == 'Solar Photovoltaic' (1,100 of 2,360 planned generators).
For permitting use Status (L) approvals pending (182), (P) approvals not initiated (167) and (T) approvals received, not under construction (140); (U), (V), (TS) are construction.
Cancelled or indefinitely postponed PV generators are in sheet 'Canceled or Postponed' (636 PV rows).
Use the plant and county to look for the actual permit file in the state or federal register.
reading_traps: Entity Name is the survey respondent/owner, which may be a project subsidiary or a future operator rather than the developer.
Rows are generators, not projects: one plant can have several rows.
Status is EIA survey vocabulary; it has no event date and is not a permit decision.
Planned Operation Month/Year is the expected in-service date, not the date of the permitting stage.
Capacity basis (AC nameplate) is stated only by column name; DC capacity is not in the Planned sheet.

problems: Records_total counts solar PV rows in the Planned sheet.

evidence.claim: EIA page: monthly survey of existing and proposed units at plants of at least 1 MW.
Observed in the Planned sheet: 1,100 solar PV generators; status counts U 264, V 250, L 182, P 167, T 140, TS 97; all 1,100 with latitude/longitude; top states TX 167, IL 141, CA 88, NY 88.

how_to_use.example_request: Open https://dps.ny.gov/ores-permit-applications and follow the docket link of 'Addison Solar' (23-03015) to https://documents.dps.ny.gov/public/MatterManagement/CaseMaster.aspx?MatterSeq=85427&MNO=23-03015

steps: Open the ORES permit applications page and read each section table.
Keep rows whose name or description says Solar; read the stage from the section heading.
Open the docket link (CaseMaster) for filings, dates and parties.
Take dates from the filings (the list itself only dates withdrawals: Flat Creek relinquished effective 2026-10-06; Moss Ridge withdrawn 2025-05-07).
reading_traps: The list and the docket can disagree: Addison Solar is 120 MW 'ADDISON SOLAR, LLC' in the list but 105 MW 'WEB Addison Solar, LLC' in the docket title.
Section counts include wind projects (e.g. North Country Wind, Bull Run Wind, whose description mentions a Solar Energy Facility).
No date column; Flat Creek and Moss Ridge are the only rows with dates.
A status map (ArcGIS dashboard) is linked but was not opened.

problems: No export on the page; the data must be scraped from the HTML tables.
Docket page capture shows no status field and zero calendar entries; the filings tab lists 297 documents but rows were not captured.
